kitEvidence.formula:
Maokai flings a sapling, which stands watch for [30] seconds. Saplings chase nearby enemies, detonating on arrival to deal [50 / 75 / 100 / 125 / 150 + (0.25) × AP + (0.05) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] magic damage and Slow surrounding enemies by [45]% for [2] seconds. Sap Magic's Cooldown is reduced by an additional 4 seconds if the sapling hits an enemy champion or epic monster.

If placed in brush, Saplings instead last for [30 + (0.015) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] seconds and cause a larger explosion, dealing [100 / 150 / 200 / 250 / 300 + (0.5) × AP + (0.1) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] magic damage over [2] seconds and Slowing enemies by [0.45 + (0.0001) × AP + ((0.01) × (0.01)) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]].
